mentions.name: Async timezone team collaboration tool
mentions.description: A tool that helps teams in different time zones collaborate asynchronously, using LLM and agentic workflows to resolve blockers and consensus-seeking problems across time zones.
mentions.problem: Blockers and consensus-seeking problems across time zones make async work between distributed teams difficult.
mentions.audience: Teams in different time zones doing async work
mentions.source_excerpt:
I have been thinking about building a tool to help teams in different time zones do async work properly. Now with the raise of LLM and agentic workflows/runtimes, it all seems possible so got started on it last weekend.

For now I have a clear vision about what the product should be, what it should do. Mainly, it's a product that should resolve blockers and consensus-seeking problems across time zones.
